name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Deliveries, quotes, credit and the rules, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Today's delivery runs
sections.note: Orders still open on a truck today need picking now.
sections.sql: select code, slot, truck, order_code, account, site, weight_kg, status, order_status from merchant.dispatch_board where run_on = current_date order by slot, truck

sections.title: Truck loads, today on
sections.sql: select run_on, slot, truck, drops, load_kg, capacity_kg, load_pct, flag from merchant.truck_load where run_on >= current_date order by run_on, slot, truck

sections.title: Quotes to chase
sections.note: Gone quiet past the chase line, or past their validity. Biggest first.
sections.sql: select code, account_name account, job, rep, value_cents, days_since_contact, state from merchant.quote_pipeline q, merchant.settings s where state in ('chase', 'expired') order by value_cents desc

sections.title: Credit watch
sections.sql: select code, name, credit_limit_cents, balance_cents owing_cents, uninvoiced_cents, oldest_overdue_days, flag from merchant.credit_watch c, merchant.settings s where flag <> '' order by oldest_overdue_days desc

sections.title: Rule findings
sections.note: Each rule and its source is in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, severity, ref, subject, detail from merchant.compliance_findings order by severity = 'breach' desc, rule

name: yard
title: The yard
subtitle: Stock by branch: short, to reorder, and tying up cash

sections.title: Short or due to reorder
sections.note: Available is on hand less what open orders at that branch need.
sections.sql: select code, name, branch, unit, on_hand, committed, available, reorder_point, flag from merchant.stock_position where flag in ('SHORT', 'reorder') order by flag = 'SHORT' desc, code

sections.title: Slow stock
sections.sql: select code, name, branch, on_hand, unit, stock_value_cents, last_sold_on, days_since_sale from merchant.stock_position p, merchant.settings s where flag = 'slow' order by stock_value_cents desc

sections.title: Prices under cost
sections.sql: select kind, account, account_name, product, price_cents, cost_cents, margin_pct, cost_changed_on from merchant.price_floor p, merchant.settings s order by margin_pct

name: accounts
title: Trade accounts
subtitle: Who owes what, who is buying less, and margin by account

sections.title: Aged debtors
sections.sql: select code, name, current_cents, overdue_1_30_cents, overdue_31_60_cents, overdue_60_plus_cents, balance_cents total_cents from merchant.account_position a, merchant.settings s where balance_cents > 0 order by overdue_60_plus_cents desc, balance_cents desc

sections.title: Buying less than they used to
sections.sql: select code, name, rep, sales_prior_90_cents, sales_90_cents, last_order_on from merchant.account_position a, merchant.settings s where sales_prior_90_cents > 0 and sales_90_cents < sales_prior_90_cents * (100 - s.sales_drop_pct) / 100.0

sections.title: Margin by account, last 90 days
sections.sql: select code, name, rep, price_level, orders, sales_cents, margin_cents, margin_pct from merchant.account_margin m, merchant.settings s order by margin_pct

sections.title: Reps, last 180 days
sections.sql: select rep, quotes, won, lost, open, win_rate_pct, quoted_cents, won_cents, open_cents from merchant.rep_scorecard r, merchant.settings s order by won_cents desc
